name: last30days-skill
description: AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web - then synthesizes a grounded summary
one_liner: An AI skill that reads what people are actually saying across Reddit, X, YouTube, Hacker News, and prediction markets on any topic, then writes you a trustworthy summary of what's really happening.
buyer: A social media manager or small marketing agency that needs to know what's trending in a niche right now without paying for an expensive social-listening platform.
business_use_cases: A marketing agency runs it each morning to brief clients on what's trending in their industry before competitors react.
A newsletter writer builds a paid weekly 'state of the niche' digest for a specific community, such as indie hackers or fitness.
A trader or analyst cross-references social sentiment against prediction-market odds before making a call.

money_ideas.idea: A paid weekly trend-digest newsletter for a specific niche
One-off trend-report deliverables sold to marketing agencies

steal_this: Pick a niche you know well, run it daily for a week, and sell the resulting digest to five people in that community.
